## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test:unit` (and the Studio tests if `sanity/` changed)
- [ ] `npm run build && npm run test:artifact` if pages, headers or `public/` changed
- [ ] Looked at the result in both languages and on a phone-width screen, if the change is visual

## Review notes

- [ ] No secret, token, personal address or full-resolution photo added
- [ ] Documentation and tests updated together when an invariant changed
- [ ] Needs a deploy to take effect (Studio publish or manual `deploy-ovh.yml`): yes / no
